_about: DEATHFIX v92 (DeathTable.cs, DuelFighter.Die). The Mixamo death clip (4.4 s, the same take on Joan / Pitborn / Dracula) keeps the hips at standing height until ~1.1 s (hips z 0.95 at 0..1.2 s, 0.80 at 1.6, 0.48 at 2.0, 0.12 from 2.8 s: measured from Pitborn_combat.glb / Joan_combat.glb / Dracula_combat.glb), so a fighter at 0 HP stood for ~1.5 s. startSeconds skips that lead-in (the knees buckle right after the killing blow); downStartSeconds = the clip's floor pose for a fighter killed while knocked down (FState.Down) so it does not pop upright. Rows keyed by roster id; character '' = default. enforceZeroHp: Duel.Update kills any fighter at 0 HP that is not Dead (finisher scenes excluded).

rows.note: default row (any character without its own row)
